name: Build v176: Hardware Loopback Auto-Detection & Web App Live Length Slider
features: Hardware Loopback Auto-Detection on Pin D9 (GPIO 9): Optional 4th wire from last LED DOUT enables 25ms boot measurement of exact strand length
Live Web App Strand Length Slider: Direct real-time control over LED count (10 to 150) in Open POI Studio with instant on-board Flash NVS persistence
Dynamic 150-LED Maximum Buffer: NeoPixelBus expands capacity to 150 LEDs with automatic blanking of unused pixels
Flash Memory Storage: Board remembers your calibrated LED count across power cycles without needing a phone or controller
Intelligent Source Discrimination: Master Bridge vs Web Studio vs Standalone 60s Flow Mode fully preserved and scaled to active strand length
